heads.t: 中國央視前主持人抵台尋庇護！機場拍片求援 移民署回應了 中國央視前主持人程萬軍自述遭迫害，11月2日自泰國搭機抵達桃園國際機場後，公開拍片求援，盼來台尋求短期人道保護。程萬軍此次僅持轉機安排，未獲准入境，目前仍受管制，移民署已將案件交由國境事務大隊統籌，並安排固定場所供餐及住宿，後續處置尚待陸委會指示。 2 分鐘前｜社會 中國央視前主持人抵台尋庇護！機場拍片求援 移民署回應了 2 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: The Department of Immigration responded that China's former host, Cheng Wan Jun, had been persecuted, and on November 2nd, after Thailand had flown to the International Airport in Tokyo, had made a public call for help, hoping for short-term humanitarian protection. In this case, the Chongwan Army, which has only made arrangements for a change of venue and has not been allowed to enter the country, is still under control, and the Immigration Department has referred the case to the National Task Force and has made arrangements for regular feeding and accommodation, pending instructions from the Commission. 2 minutes ago, China's host arrived to seek asylum! The airport shot for help.

heads.t: 台股暴跌1612點創史上第7大跌點！失守44000點 金管會回應了 台股今天終場下跌1612.60點，跌幅3.59%。金管會表示，國際股市有些波動，連帶影響台股波動較大，觀察亞洲主要股市今天截至下午1時30分漲跌情形，南韓跌幅3.78%、上海綜合跌1.39%、新加坡跌0.59%、香港漲0.37%、日本休市。台股跌勢介於亞洲主要股市之間，金管會會持續關注近期股市波動情況。 16 分鐘前｜財經 台股暴跌1612點創史上第7大跌點！失守44000點 金管會回應了 16 分鐘前｜財經
heads.en: The 7th down point in the history of 1612. The missing 44,000 points will respond to the fall of 1612.60 points in the end today, which is 3.59 per cent. According to the International Stock Market, there has been some movement, and the inter-connected influence has increased, observing the collapse of major Asian stock markets as of 1.30 p.m. today, with a drop of 3.78 per cent in South Korea, 1.39 per cent in Shanghai, 0.59 per cent in Singapore, 0.37 per cent in Hong Kong, and a fall in Japan. The fall in shares is between major Asian stock markets, and the Council will keep an eye on recent stock market developments. 16 minutes ago, the bank fell to the seventh point in the history of 1612!
